about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Third Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O Lord, Who grantest us the use of such great mysteries, we beseech Thee to make us truly conform ourselves to their effects. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
